setup.command: if ! command -v tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr; fi && if ! tesseract --list-langs 2>/dev/null | grep -qx ben; then apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr-ben; fi && if ! tesseract --list-langs 2>/dev/null | grep -qx eng; then apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr-eng; fi && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements.txt
